title: Bring the tmx engine up to its own R4 critical-tier floor
description: Dogfooding (2026-09-26): this repo's own gate fails on its PR-tier self-audit. The critical tier (cover.py, gate.py, rigor.py, matrix.py at R4) scores 58.0% against the 0.80 floor, with about 170 survivors untriaged; the standard tier scores 27.5% against 0.60, because pycollect.py and probation.py are exercised only by the nightly slow tier. Many cover.py survivors are search heuristics that change speed rather than the answer: pin them with efficiency properties or triage them as equivalent, with reasons.

acceptanceCriteria.text: tmx gate --matrix on the PR-tier self-audit passes the R4 critical tier (>= 0.80, every survivor killed or triaged with a reason)
Nightly-tier self-audit recorded for pycollect.py and probation.py

implementationNotes: Slice plan (recorded before the first PR). Critical tier = cover.py, gate.py, rigor.py, matrix.py at R4: floor 0.80 plus every survivor killed or triaged. Baseline (committed matrix .tmx/self3.json): 412 mutants, 239 killed, 58.0%; survivors 173 (cover.py 59 survived + 11 uncovered, gate.py 32+40, rigor.py 5+11, matrix.py 7+8). The floor needs about 91 more KILLS: triage does not count toward it (mutation_score is killed over total; testing/survivors.json only silences the per-survivor check, it never reclassifies a mutant to equivalent). Slice 1 (this PR): the whole critical tier - focused property/table tests to kill at least 91 mutants, plus triage of the residual roughly 82 equivalent survivors in testing/survivors.json with reasons; AC0 met. Slice 2: AC1 - record a nightly-tier self-audit for pycollect.py and probation.py. Note: the 0.80 floor is aggregate over the tier and the survivor check is all-or-nothing, so a per-module slice cannot be green on its own; the atomic unit is the whole critical tier. A fresh matrix is being rebuilt against HEAD (the committed one is from 2026-09-26); numbers will be corrected from it.
